tools.name: search_products
tools.description: SEMANTIC product discovery: describe the need in plain words (industry, infrastructure type, hazard, question) and get products ranked by profile match (answers_questions, use_cases, industries, infrastructure_types, hazard_classes, example_questions), with the matched terms, what each product is NO

tools.name: inspect_product
tools.description: The full machine-readable commercial contract of one product: pricing ladder, credit multipliers, views, schema, measured quality, SLOs, provenance, join quality, semantics (ships through risk indicator), limitations.

tools.name: sample_product
tools.description: Free sample rows of a product (k-anonymised where applicable) with data_through and contract version.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Ask a question Atlas can answer live (seismic unusual in a region, wave energy, commodity regimes, logistics safety, what cells are alert-worthy). Returns verdict, evidence, datasets and the purchase path.

tools.name: quote_request
tools.description: Quote a dataset need: text / keywords / category, max_age_hours, budget_usd, resolution, window_days, records, region or bbox. Returns ranked products with the cheapest fitting tier, estimated records and credits, cost, and the exact purchase call.

tools.name: quote_watch
tools.description: Quote a watch (signal feed): need text plus filters (bbox, cohorts, signals, min_severity, min_confidence) -> product (ranked like quote_request, among packs with the cell layer), cheapest tier that meets the need, best tier within budget, estimated events per month and credits (watch events cost 5

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Change events since a cursor. Anonymous: the latest-day preview, at most 10 events (limit_applied/limit_max in the response). With api_key: the metered signal feed for that subscription (GET /api/feeds/{slug}/changes).

tools.name: get_entitlement
tools.description: What an api_key is entitled to and has used: tier, credits quota, used, remaining, projected cost of a request, reset date.

tools.name: buy_product
tools.description: The exact purchase call for a product and tier (one-time pack via POST /api/datapacks/buy, subscription via POST /api/feeds/subscribe), with terms, idempotency and what is metered. Does not move money: purchases need a session (or Stripe checkout).

tools.name: create_watch
tools.description: The exact subscribe call for a watch (mode=watch) with the filters given, its tier, price and metering, plus the webhook contract. Does not move money.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_changes" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?src=mcp_registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_changes · Private data: quote_request · Public sink: buy_product, create_watch · Destructive: get_entitlement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_changes · Private data: quote_request · Public sink: buy_product, create_watch · Destructive: get_entitlement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
